patch_description: Replace the purely nonsmooth minimum-area DE objective with a lexicographic lower-tail objective. The true minimum remains the dominant term, while a very small secondary reward for the mean of the twelve smallest determinants encourages configurations with a broad, well-shaped active constraint set rather than a single fragile bottleneck. This is particularly useful before the oriented SLSQP maximin polish: DE can enter a stronger combinatorial basin, while SLSQP still restores the exact maximin solution. The reduced DE iteration budget offsets the slightly more elaborate objective and improves evaluation time.
